jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Technical, Amazon Business
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Join Amazon Business — a multi-billion global B2B marketplace — and lead the product strategy that powers how the world's largest enterprises manage their procurement accounts. As a Sr. PMT on the Amazon Business Foundational Services team, you'll build the enterprise-grade capabilities that enable Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies to onboard, govern, and procure across countries, currencies, and compliance regimes.  
  

* Own 0-to-1 product launches that directly impact how multinational organizations adopt Amazon Business
* Define the multi-year roadmap for Business Account Management — one of the highest-visibility charters in AB
* Partner with engineering to architect scalable, secure, globally distributed systems
* Work backwards from C-suite procurement leaders, IT admins, and end-users at the world's biggest companies
* Operate in a fast-moving startup environment backed by Amazon's scale, data, and infrastructure

  
About Amazon Business  
Come be a part of a rapidly expanding multi-billion-dollar global business. At Amazon Business, a fast-growing startup passionate about building solutions, we set out every day to innovate and disrupt the status quo. We stand at the intersection of tech & retail in the B2B space developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations thrive. At Amazon Business, we strive to be the most recognized and preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. Bring your insight, imagination and a healthy disregard for the impossible. Join us in building and celebrating the value of Amazon Business to buyers of all sizes and industries.
  
  
Role Description  
We are looking for a high-performing Senior Product Manager – Technical to own and drive the product strategy for enterprise-ready Business Account Management capabilities, with a focus on enabling large multinational organizations to seamlessly adopt and scale Amazon Business across their global operations.  
In this role, you will work backwards from the needs of enterprise procurement leaders, IT administrators, and end-users at Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies to define, build, and launch capabilities that simplify account onboarding, user governance, organizational hierarchy management, and cross-border account administration. You will build AI and agentic solutions to automate account configuration, administration tasks, and intelligent onboarding workflows for enterprise customers. You will partner closely with engineering, UX, sales, and business development teams to deliver scalable solutions that meet the complex requirements of multinational enterprises — including SSO/SAML integration, multi-entity account structures, delegated administration, compliance controls, and global account consolidation.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Product Strategy & Vision: Define the product vision and multi-year roadmap for enterprise Business Account Management capabilities, aligning with Amazon Business’s global growth strategy for large multinational customers.
* Work Backwards from the Customer: Deeply understand the needs of enterprise procurement, IT, and finance stakeholders at large multinational organizations; translate those needs into clear product requirements and user stories.
* Enterprise-Ready Capabilities: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for features such as multi-entity account hierarchies, cross-border account management, SSO/identity federation, delegated admin controls, bulk user provisioning, and compliance/governance frameworks.
* Technical Depth: Collaborate with engineering teams to define system architecture, AI solutions, make technical trade-offs, and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and performant across global regions.
* Stakeholder Management: Provide effective written and verbal updates on product performance to leadership and stakeholders; influence technical priorities and business strategy through data-driven contributions.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Business Development, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure product capabilities meet the regulatory and operational requirements of multinational enterprises across diverse markets.
* Data-Driven Decision Making: Define and track success metrics; retrieve and analyze feedback from customers, stakeholders, and partner teams to shape requirements and prioritize the roadmap.
* Innovation: Identify new opportunities to innovate on behalf of enterprise customers; deliver innovative, simple solutions that impact thousands of business customers globally.

  
A day in the life  
You will define and prioritize the product roadmap for enterprise account management, writing requirements and leading sprint planning with engineering. Day-to-day, you'll conduct customer discovery calls with Fortune 500 procurement leaders and IT administrators, analyze account onboarding and adoption metrics, and author product artifacts to align stakeholders and leadership. You'll partner with Sales, Business Development, UX, and Legal stakeholders to unblock enterprise deals and resolve complex multi-country account configuration challenges. Core problems include simplifying multinational account hierarchies, scaling identity federation, and reducing enterprise onboarding friction.  
  
About the team  
The Foundational Services team within Amazon Business is responsible for giving large business customers a seamless and robust experience to onboard and manage their employees' accounts using Amazon Business. Our charter spans enterprise-grade account management capabilities that power the world's largest B2B procurement organizations. We are building the next generation of enterprise-ready capabilities to serve large multinational customers operating across multiple countries, currencies, and regulatory environments.

jobs.title: Manager – ERC Innovation Product Assurance
jobs.description:
### **Summary**

ERC Innovation develops and supports a portfolio of products and technology-enabled solutions that strengthen Ethics, Risk & Compliance capabilities. These products support a range of business processes and user groups across the organization.
  
The Product Assurance function ensures that ERC products are reliable, well-supported and continuously improved throughout their lifecycle. The scope includes digital platforms, applications, workflow solutions, reporting products, automation and AI-enabled capabilities, together with their related processes and integrations.
  
  
Job Purpose
  
  
The Manager, ERC Innovation Product Assurance supports the ongoing operations, quality, adoption and continuous improvement of products in the ERC Innovation portfolio. The role works closely with Business System Owners/Product Owners, business stakeholders, vendors and IT/digital teams to keep assigned products reliable, user-friendly, well-supported and aligned with agreed business requirements.
  
This is a product assurance and operational support role. It does not carry Business/System Owner or Product Owner accountability.

### **About the Role**

**Product Operations & Support**
--------------------------------

* Provide operational support for assigned ERC products, including user queries, service requests and coordination of product-related issues.
* Monitor support trends, user feedback, open defects and enhancement requests to support prioritization and continuous improvement.
* Support incident, change and release activities in partnership with IT/digital teams, vendors, Business/System Owners and business stakeholders.

**Testing & Release Assurance**

* Execute and coordinate testing for defect fixes, enhancements, configuration and workflow updates, integrations and new functionality across assigned products.
* Prepare and execute test cases in appropriate test environments, document outcomes and run readiness checks before production deployment.
* Help maintain practical testing standards and structured test records for product changes.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with Business/System Owners, GPOs, Business Coordinators, vendors and IT/digital teams to keep communication clear and follow-up on product changes tight.
* Track actions on defects, enhancements, release items, user feedback, training needs and operational improvements.
* Support structured discussions with process and business stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify impacts and confirm operational readiness.

**Configuration & Administration Support**

* Support product configuration and administration, including master data maintenance, user onboarding/offboarding, access management coordination, organizational unit updates and activity/category changes.
* Maintain configuration documentation, operating procedures, release documentation and support records.
* Escalate technical, functional or data issues to the right owners and follow through to resolution.

**User Enablement, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and maintain training materials, quick reference guides, user communications, knowledge articles and product support content.
* Provide functional guidance to users on business processes and product usage, under the guidance of the relevant Business/System Owner or Product Owner.
* Build and maintain dashboards, KPIs, Power BI reports and operational insights covering product support, adoption and service quality.
* Identify automation, simplification and productivity opportunities, including AI-enabled ones, to improve user experience and product effectiveness.

**Essential Requirements**

* **8+ years of experience** in product operations, business applications support, service management, digital product support or technology-enabled business processes.
* Proven experience supporting enterprise products and platforms, working across business, technology, vendor and operational teams in a global environment.
* Hands-on experience in testing, defect management, release support, incident management, change management, application support or platform operations.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and driving follow-up on system enhancements, operational improvements and user adoption.
* Experience creating and interpreting KPIs, dashboards, Power BI reports and operational metrics.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, planning and organizational skills.
* University degree or equivalent experience in Business, Technology, Operations, Life Sciences or a related discipline.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Understanding of Ethics, Risk & Compliance processes and how they are supported by digital products.
* Understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and its business context.
* Experience with enterprise workflow platforms, ServiceNow, Power BI, Excel or AI-enabled solutions.

jobs.title: Product Manager | Payments & Cards
jobs.description:
**About the company**

**Calamatta Cuschieri Moneybase plc** is a privately held Fintech Group that operates in Investment Services, Fund Administration, Online Investing, and Payments. With roots dating back to 1971, the Group today is evolving at a fast pace whilst keeping the same core principles, that of providing clients the best service using the latest technology and the top professionals in their field, whilst ensuring the strong governance and ethics.

We are committed to attracting and selecting the very best people to join our team and to creating a workplace that promotes individual career growth; we value our people and their well-being. The group employs over 210 people from over 27 countries around the world with Assets Under Management and Administration of over 3 billion.

**About the role**

We are looking for a **Product Manager** to own the product vision and roadmap for our **Payments & Cards** portfolio. Working in a fast-moving and cross-functional environment, we are looking for solid experience in owning and guiding the design and delivery of products and services as well as team leadership background. This position forms part of an agile development team, building and working on enterprise-grade software systems. The Product Manager will serve as a subject matter expert, acting as a central point of reference for both the team and other stakeholders within the organisation.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for the Payments and Cards portfolio aligned to company KPIs and customer needs.
* Define, prioritise, and ship features that improve activation rates, usage and engagement, and retention across the payments and cards journeys.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure products meet card scheme rules (Visa/Mastercard), PCI-DSS, and relevant financial regulation (e.g. PSD2) from design through to launch.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, and Data teams to translate customer problems into shipped, measurable product improvements.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with third-party partners, e.g. card issuers/processors, payment service providers and card schemes.
* Own the customer experience for card servicing, including freezing/unfreezing cards, replacement, PIN management, and in-app card controls as well as payment solutions, including traditional payment rails (SEPA/SWIFT) as well as fintech payment features (e.g. pay by link and P2P via mobile). Collaborate with UX/UI designers to this effect.
* Communicate roadmap, trade-offs, and progress clearly to stakeholders and leadership, including regular reporting on delivery status and product KPIs.
* Stay close to the competitive landscape — challenger banks, neobanks, and card issuers globally — to keep the product proposition sharp and differentiated.
* Accountable for the on-time and quality delivery of assigned projects
* Conduct team appraisals, identifying training needs, motivating and performance managing the team in collaboration with the Team Lead
* Implement mechanisms to monitor, manage and provide progress on all delivery activities within the team. Develop and maintain an appropriately prioritized product backlog for the team.
* Act as an ambassador for the product internally and externally and as a point of reference for queries related to the product

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Finance, Economics, or a related field
* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is a plus
* Formal certification in product management (e.g. CSPO) is beneficial

**Required Experience**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally within a digital bank, fintech, card issuer, or payments company
* Direct experience owning a card product (debit, credit, or prepaid) end-to-end, including working with card processors/issuers and scheme relationships (Visa/Mastercard) and payments vertical, including working with service providers
* Track record of shipping customer-facing features in a fast-paced, agile environment, with clear evidence of measurable impact (conversion, activation, NPS, revenue)
* Experience operating within a regulated environment, working alongside Risk, Compliance, and Legal teams on product decisions
* Experience working in a scale-up or high-growth fintech environment, comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration
* A background in software development would be considered an asset

**Skill Requirements**

* Strong product sense: ability to translate customer pain points and business goals into a clear, prioritised roadmap.
* Analytical and metrics-driven: comfortable interpreting data, and using it to make and defend product decisions.
* Deep understanding of card payment rails, authorisation flows, settlement, and the wider card issuing ecosystem as well as the payments landscape within the EU.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to influence engineering, design, risk, and leadership alike.
* Strong commercial acumen — understanding of interchange, unit economics, and how card products drive revenue and cost.
* User-centred mindset, with experience running user research, usability testing, or working closely with design teams.
* Comfortable operating autonomously, owning outcomes rather than outputs, in a culture that values speed and iteration over process.
* Knowledge of fraud prevention, dispute management, and chargeback processes is a strong advantage.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and tools such as Jira, Linear, or similar.

**What we offer**

As a HR certified employer, we invest seriously in our people through clear career paths, strong benefits, and an environment built for high ownership and high performance.

* Full-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

You’ll own one or more parts of the traveller journey across app and web; we’ll set the exact charter with you. Work on our roadmap includes:

Search and booking — comparing buses, smarter filters, a cleaner seat layout and fewer payment drop-offs.

The trip — an AI-powered Trip Mode, live tracking, delay alerts and boarding-point guidance.

Cancellations and refunds — alternatives before a cancel, clear refund tracking and easy reschedules.

Growth and monetisation — rewards and referrals, cross-sell and upsell, and supply-side monetisation through operator ads and sponsored listings.

**What you’ll do**

Own outcomes — set the roadmap and KPIs for your area, and own the results.

Find the real problem — talk to travellers, bus operators, sales and on-ground teams and support, and keep asking why until you reach the root cause.

Design the experience — sketch and prototype, and work with designers to craft “aha” moments and delightful nudges.

Build with AI — prototype faster, and turn manual, support-heavy journeys into self-serve ones.

Let data decide — pull your own data, run A/B tests and challenge assumptions.

Ship end to end — write clear specs, launch smoothly, keep improving, and keep engineering, design and business aligned.

**What success looks like**

Measurable gains in your metrics — conversion, repeat bookings, app ratings, fewer support contacts.

Superlative experiences, with clear “aha” moments and delightful nudges that travellers notice.

At least one manual journey made self-serve with AI.

**Who you are**

A PM who thinks like a designer and notices friction others miss.

Deeply empathetic — you feel the traveller’s worries before you design for them.

A design thinker who frames the problem before jumping to a solution, and tests early with real users.

Comfortable with data and AI tools, a clear communicator, and high on ownership.

**Qualifications**

2–4 years of product management experience on customer-facing (B2C) app or web products.

A track record of shipping features end to end and moving a metric you can name.

Hands-on SQL and analytics — funnels, cohorts, A/B tests (tools like Mixpanel, CleverTap, GA or similar).

Practical use of AI tools in product work — e.g. ChatGPT or Claude for research and specs, and Figma AI, Lovable, Cursor or similar for prototyping.

Hands-on with design thinking and user research — interviews, usability tests, journey mapping — and able to create wireframes and clickable prototypes in Figma or similar tools.

Clear written and verbal communication.

A UX, UI or product design background. Please include a portfolio if you have one.

An MBA from a reputed business school.

**Good to have**

Experience in travel, mobility, e-commerce, payments or marketplaces.

Experience with conversational AI, offers or loyalty products.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Thousands of UK accountancy practices rely on our software every day to run their firms, serve their clients and meet their compliance obligations. As Product Manager, you will own part of that portfolio and help take it from a set of well-run products to a connected, AI-enabled platform that practices and partners can build on. This is a build-and-converge mandate, not a maintenance role.
  
  
The Product Manager role is changing. AI is changing the way we work: the time from idea to working software is shrinking, prototyping is moving towards real development with tools like Claude Code, and the lines between product, engineering and design are blurring. The successful candidate will be flexible and willing to lean into that change, and will partner heavily with engineering and design, shaping, prototyping and building alongside them rather than handing over documents.
  
  
You will use the latest AI tools to move from idea to validated prototype faster than traditional product management allows, in a team that treats AI as part of its everyday toolkit.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Practices are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.
* Clients expect a modern, mobile, trustworthy way to share documents and receive finished work.
* Document data extraction, preparation and review are going AI-native, and practices are adopting agentic tools now.
* Practices increasingly want open APIs, so their own portals, data and reporting stay connected as the market converges.
* Regulatory change, such as Making Tax Digital, keeps raising the bar for reliability at filing peaks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the product vision and roadmap. Balance customer needs, regulatory change and commercial priorities into a clear, evidence-based plan, and own the commercially consequential decisions that follow from it.
* Deliver the portfolio, season over season. Own your products end to end, at the reliability and scale that filing deadlines and compliance peaks demand.
* Converge products without disrupting customers. Bring overlapping products and capabilities together into one connected experience for every practice and client, and migrate existing customers without breaking what they rely on.
* Componentise the portfolio. Turn each part of the product into reusable workflow components that can be recomposed across the practice workflow and the wider platform, rather than locked inside a single application.
* Open the platform through APIs and orchestration. Expand the API surface (open APIs, events and integrations) as a first-class capability, so practices and partners embed our products in their own portals and workflows, and AI agents and partner systems can coordinate work programmatically.
* Bring agentic, AI-driven workflows to practices. Work with the platform team to bring AI-driven extraction, preparation and review into the product experience, so more of the work shifts from practice staff to the platform while the practice stays in control.
* Turn customer problems into well-defined solutions. Use AI tools to turn customer problems into clear, testable requirements that engineering and design can build from with confidence, in whatever form works best for the team.
* Prototype early, then build. Use Claude Code or similar tools to build working prototypes that test ideas with customers and stakeholders before significant engineering investment is made, and increasingly contribute real, reviewed code alongside engineering.
* Partner heavily with engineering and design. Work side by side with engineers and designers, often shaping ideas together in prototypes and in the build itself, to prioritise the backlog, clarify requirements and remove blockers, so valuable releases reach customers predictably.
* Listen to customers and use data to decide. Run discovery with accountants and practice staff, work with large practices as design partners, and use usage analytics and support insight to measure whether what we ship delivers real outcomes.
* Keep stakeholders informed and aligned. Communicate progress, trade-offs and decisions clearly to senior leaders, sales, support and customer-facing teams.
* Raise the team's AI capability. Share effective prompts, skills, workflows and lessons learned so that AI-assisted product practice becomes the norm across the team.

What success looks like
  
  

* Practices experience one connected workflow, whatever mix of products they run today.
* Our APIs are something practices and partners actively build on, not a bespoke integration project.
* Practices reach AI-driven, agentic preparation and review through our products, season over season.
* Clients get a simpler, faster, more trustworthy experience, and practices see measurably less manual work.
* Releases land predictably, and roadmap decisions are backed by customer evidence and usage data.
* Colleagues across the team are using AI-assisted ways of working because you showed them how.

**Required Qualifications**
Education and experience
  
  

* Degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 or more years as a Product Manager or Product Owner in a software product environment, delivering in an agile/scrum setting.
* Demonstrable experience turning customer problems into clear requirements and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can deliver against.
* Experience working on platform, API or developer-facing capabilities, not only features on top of them.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

  

We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and ship production-grade GenAI systems for our clients. You'll own solutions end to end: RAG systems, chatbots, and AI agents that are reliable, observable, and cost-efficient in production. This role is about applied LLM engineering, not training models from scratch.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Design and build RAG pipelines end to end, covering document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation
* Build conversational AI and chatbots with multi-turn memory, grounding, fallback handling, and human-handoff flows
* Develop AI agents and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, or CrewAI, including tool calling, planning, and state management
* Build and integrate MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and clients to connect LLMs with client systems, APIs, and data sources
* Apply context engineering to decide what goes into the context window (retrieval, memory, tool outputs, summarisation, compaction) for accuracy and efficiency
* Optimise prompts systematically through versioning, A/B testing, and automated approaches (e.g., DSPy), not trial and error
* Manage tokenomics: track and reduce token usage and cost through prompt caching, model routing, batching, and right-sizing models per task
* Evaluate, optimise, and monitor AI system performance for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost, using tracing and observability tools like LangSmith, Langfuse, or Arize Phoenix; after deployment, catch issues such as data drift, prompt or model regressions, and degraded accuracy, and ship fixes
* Build evaluation frameworks with golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression evals, and online/offline metrics, so that quality is measured before and after release
* Implement guardrails for prompt-injection defence, PII handling, output validation, and hallucination controls
* Collaborate with product managers, backend engineers, frontend developers, and clients to identify opportunities for AI-driven solutions, applying emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and best practices to real business problems; mentor junior AI engineers
* Fine-tune open-weight models (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma) using LoRA/QLoRA, SFT, or DPO when prompting and RAG aren't enough, and decide when fine-tuning is actually justified (an added advantage)

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

  

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years building and shipping LLM-based applications to production
* Strong Python skills (async, APIs, testing); FastAPI or similar
* Hands-on experience with LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock / Azure OpenAI), including tool calling and structured outputs
* Proven experience building RAG systems, and an understanding of why they fail (retrieval quality, chunking, context limits)
* Experience building AI agents with LangGraph or an equivalent framework, and hands-on experience building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and clients
* Working knowledge of vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar) and embedding models
* Practical experience with LLM evaluation and observability tooling
* Clear understanding of LLM cost and latency trade-offs and how to optimise them
* Experience deploying AI services on a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) with Docker and CI/CD

  

**Good to Have**

  

* Hands-on fine-tuning experience (Hugging Face, Unsloth, Axolotl) and model serving (vLLM, Ollama, TGI)
* Experience with the A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol
* Familiarity with prompt optimisation frameworks such as DSPy
* Multimodal experience (vision + language, document parsing)
* Exposure to AI security and governance practices (red-teaming, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs)
* Client-facing delivery experience in a services or consulting setup
* Open-source contributions in the GenAI space

  

**What We Offer**

  

* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with chance to shape a growing AI practice: its patterns, tooling, and standards
* A collaborative, engineering-driven culture
* Competitive compensation and growth opportunitiesRole & responsibilities

**About Mallow Technologies**

  

Mallow Technologies is a product engineering and development company building digital products for businesses across the globe. We partner with clients to design, build and scale software products end to end.

  

**About the Role**

  

We're looking for Product Owners who thrive in turning problems into working software. While high-level direction may come from product discovery, you'll take it from there defining the right solution for a given problem or need, breaking it down into implementable scope and owning the journey all the way through to a shipped, working product in production. You'll be the bridge between the client's vision, the internal delivery team and the end outcome making sure the right things get built, in the right order, at the right quality and that they land successfully in the hands of users.

  

This role is best suited for someone who enjoys both the problem-solving side figuring out the 'what' and 'how' of a solution and the structure and momentum of seeing it through to a working, live product on a predictable cadence.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define the right solution for a given problem, pain point, or business need and translate it into detailed, implementable scope covering user flows, edge cases, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Own and continuously groom the product backlog, prioritizing items in collaboration with clients based on business value, technical dependencies, and delivery timelines.

* 3-5 years of overall experience, with at least 2 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst on client-facing projects.

**What You Can Expect**

  

* Ownership of real client products from backlog to delivery.
* A collaborative team culture where Designers, Engineers, and QA work closely together.
* Exposure to multiple domains and diverse project types across our client portfolio.
* A clear growth path toward more senior roles within the Product and Delivery track.

**Accessibility Testing Expert**  
**Job ID#:26-2235**  
**Clearance: Not Required**  
**Location: Hyderabad/Vijayawada**  
  
**Who We Are**:  
Since our inception back in 2006, Navitas has grown to be an industry leader in the digital transformation space, and we’ve served as trusted advisors supporting our client base within the commercial, federal, and state and local markets.  
  
**What We Do**:  
At our very core, we’re a group of problem solvers providing our award-winning technology solutions to drive digital acceleration for our customers! With proven solutions, award-winning technologies, and a team of expert problem solvers, Navitas has consistently empowered customers to use technology as a competitive advantage and deliver cutting-edge transformative solutions.  
  
**What You’ll Do**:  
We are seeking an experienced Accessibility Testing Expert to provide advanced expertise in evaluating the accessibility and usability of digital products, applications, and content.
  
This role serves as a subject matter expert in digital accessibility and is responsible for conducting comprehensive accessibility assessments, identifying barriers that may impact people with disabilities, evaluating conformance with applicable accessibility standards, and providing clear, actionable guidance to support remediation.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in WCAG standards, assistive technologies, manual accessibility testing, accessibility testing tools, and accessible design and development practices. This individual must be able to evaluate accessibility beyond automated testing, understand the real-world impact of accessibility barriers, and translate complex technical findings into practical recommendations for technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  
  
The Accessibility Testing Expert will collaborate with developers, designers, quality assurance teams, product owners, vendors, and organizational stakeholders to integrate accessibility throughout the digital product lifecycle and support informed accessibility and compliance decisions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead comprehensive accessibility evaluations of websites, applications, and digital content to assess conformance with WCAG 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2 standards and identify barriers that may impact users with disabilities.
* Apply automated testing tools, assistive technologies, manual testing techniques, code inspection, and accessibility tree analysis to identify and validate accessibility barriers.
* Assess the severity, user impact, and accessibility risk of identified issues to support remediation prioritization and informed decision-making.
* Collaborate with developers, designers, QA, and product teams to provide clear remediation guidance, accessibility acceptance criteria, and recommendations that support accessible implementation.
* Validate accessibility remediation across iterative development cycles and confirm that identified barriers have been effectively resolved.
* Participate proactively in design and development reviews to identify accessibility risks early and embed accessibility throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review VPATs and Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACRs) and identify accessibility risks or gaps requiring further evaluation.
* Communicate accessibility findings, risks, priorities, and recommended remediation strategies to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Support accessibility evaluations during procurement, implementation, and third-party vendor reviews.
* Conduct accessibility evaluations of electronic documents, including PDF, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, against applicable WCAG, Section 508, and PDF/UA requirements.
* Validate document remediation to ensure content is correctly structured and usable with screen readers, keyboard navigation, and other assistive technologies.
* Contribute to organizational accessibility standards, testing methodologies, procedures, reusable best practices, training, and awareness initiatives.

**Required Skills**

* Advanced knowledge of WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 Level A and AA, Section 508, applicable ADA accessibility requirements, and familiarity with WCAG 2.0 for legacy content.
* Extensive hands-on experience testing with JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, and TalkBack.
* Proficiency with Axe DevTools, Accessibility Insights, WAVE, Color Contrast Analyzer, Acrobat Pro, and other accessibility testing tools.
* Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, semantic HTML, ARIA, WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices, and browser accessibility trees.
* Expertise in comprehensive manual and automated accessibility testing, including keyboard, screen reader, focus management, contrast, zoom/reflow, text spacing, and dynamic-content testing.
* Experience evaluating and remediating PDF, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel documents, including knowledge of PDF/UA.
* Experience reviewing VPATs/ACRs and assessing accessibility risk.
* Ability to map findings accurately to WCAG criteria, severity, and user impact and provide actionable remediation guidance.
* Strong analytical, technical documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to explain accessibility requirements to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple accessibility assessments and collaborate effectively across development, design, QA, product, and business teams.

  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field preferred.
* At least 8 years of professional experience performing accessibility testing and audits in web and mobile applications.
* Trusted Tester Certification issued by DHS or a similar certification in accessibility is preferred.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Business Analyst**  
**Drone Analytics Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform**

**Primary Focus:**  
User stories and acceptance criteria, story map, beta feedback triage.

**Technology Stack:**  
Jira/Confluence, Gherkin (Given/When/Then), BPMN/draw.io, Postman (API reading), basic SQL/MongoDB queries, OpenAPI.

**Role Summary:**  
1. The Business Analyst will help shape the transition of the drone analytics MVP into a multi-tenant SaaS platform.  
2. The role connects business goals, customer needs, product requirements, and technical delivery—ensuring that requirements are clear, traceable, testable, and aligned with GA readiness, customer migration, and post-launch success.

**Key Responsibilities:**   
**1. Requirements:** Run workshops and interviews with stakeholders and MVP customers. Document business, functional, and non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, availability, and compliance.  
**2. Backlog:** Write epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Jira. Keep the backlog groomed and maintain traceability from business goal to story to test case.  
**3. Analysis:** Perform MVP-to-SaaS gap analysis. Model processes and data flows (BPMN/UML) for tenants, users, subscriptions, drone assets, and inference jobs.  
**4. Billing and packaging:** Define plans, entitlements, usage metering (GB ingested, flight hours, inference minutes), proration, and overage rules with Product and Finance.  
**5. Delivery:** Join sprint ceremonies. Work with the Tech Architect, Drone Data Architect, AI/ML, and UX teams to translate business rules into technical constraints.  
**6. Quality:** Partner with QA on test strategy. Lead UAT with pilot customers and internal stakeholders.  
**7. Security and compliance:** Support control mapping for SOC 2 and privacy requirements (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR).  
**8. Migration and go-live:** Define data mapping, cutover, and rollback criteria for MVP customers. Own the GA readiness checklist and post-GA success metrics (activation, churn, time-to-first-insight).  
**9. Governance:** Manage requirements change control, the decision log, and risk inputs for the PM.

**Required Qualifications:**   
1. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.  
2. 4+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with 3+ years on B2B SaaS or cloud platforms.  
3. Experience documenting multi-tenant systems, RBAC/SSO, or subscription billing.  
4. Strong skills in user stories, acceptance criteria, process modeling, and traceability.  
5. Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, data schemas, and queue-based architectures; basic SQL.  
6. Proficiency in Jira, Confluence, and a diagramming tool (Lucidchart, Visio, or draw.io).  
7. Experience with process modelling using BPMN or flow diagrams.  
8. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to facilitate workshops with executives and engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  
1. Drone, geospatial/GIS, or infrastructure inspection experience.  
2. Knowledge of computer-vision workflows (model versioning, confidence scores, human review).  
3. Experience with usage-based billing tools (Stripe Billing, Chargebee, Zuora).  
4. AWS or Azure fundamentals; exposure to SOC 2, GDPR, or CCPA.  
5. Prior experience with MVP-to-platform or customer-migration programs.  
6. CBAP, PMI-PBA, or CSPO/PSPO certification.

**Key Deliverables:**   
1. Documented business, functional, and non-functional requirements, with traceability to backlog items and test cases.  
2. Prioritized and groomed Jira backlog containing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.  
3. MVP-to-SaaS gap analysis and BPMN/UML process and data-flow models.  
4. Defined subscription plans, entitlements, usage-metering rules, proration, and overage requirements.  
5. UAT outcomes, GA readiness checklist, and MVP customer migration criteria.  
6. Decision log, requirements change-control records, and post-GA success metrics.

**Education:**   
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced SAP Business Analyst with strong business analysis and SAP process knowledge to work closely with business stakeholders, SAP functional consultants, technical teams, and project managers. The candidate will be responsible for gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements, understanding end-to-end business processes, identifying process gaps, and translating business needs into functional requirements and actionable user stories.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in requirement gathering, AS-IS and TO-BE process mapping, BRD/FRD preparation, user story creation, acceptance criteria definition, stakeholder coordination, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). * Collaborate with business stakeholders, process owners, and end users to gather, analyze, validate, and document business requirements.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, requirement-gathering workshops, and business discussions to understand business needs and operational challenges.
* Analyze existing business processes and document AS-IS and TO-BE workflows, identifying gaps, dependencies, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Work closely with SAP functional consultants and technical teams to understand SAP functionalities and translate business requirements into effective SAP solutions.
* Prepare and maintain Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), use cases, process flows, and other functional documentation.
* Create detailed user stories, define acceptance criteria, and maintain requirement traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

* Develop UAT test scenarios and test cases based on approved business requirements and coordinate UAT execution with business users.
* Validate SAP functionalities against business requirements, track defects, coordinate with technical and functional teams for resolution, and facilitate retesting and business sign-off.
* Maintain requirement documentation, process flows, issue logs, and project-related deliverables throughout the SDLC.

**Data Engineer**   
 **Location:Chennai | Bangalore | Hyderabad | Mumbai**  
 **Engagement model:** Full-time

**Immediate Joiners Preferred**  
 **Role Summary**   
 Timely, reliable data pipelines are what turn a platform design into business value. The Data Engineer   
 builds and operates the pipelines that move data from source systems into the lakehouse and on to analytics and AI consumers. They ensure that the pipelines are automated, performant, secure and governed.   
 The role works alongside the data architect, data quality engineer, business analysts and AI engineers. Its   
 job is to deliver production-grade pipelines on Azure / Microsoft Fabric, with metadata and lineage   
 captured in Microsoft Purview.   
 **Key Responsibilities on the Client Engagement**   
 **Pipeline development:** Build batch, incremental, CDC and streaming ingestion pipelines from source systems into the Bronze layer, using Azure Data Factory and Fabric pipelines.   
 **Transformation:** Develop Silver- and Gold-layer transformations in SQL, PySpark and Spark notebooks, including cleansing, conformance, enrichment and business-rule logic.   
 **Data modelling implementation:** Implement dimensional models, SCDs, surrogate keys and data marts according to the architect's designs.   
 **Embedded quality controls:** Integrate DQ checks, validation, quarantine and reconciliation into pipelines in partnership with the Senior Data Quality Engineer.   
 **Metadata and lineage:** Ensure that pipelines publish metadata and lineage to Microsoft Purview.   
 **Orchestration and automation:** Implement scheduling, dependency management, parameterization, error handling and alerting.   
 ¢ **Performance and cost:** Optimize pipelines, partitioning, file formats (Delta/Parquet) and compute usage for performance and cost efficiency.   
 ¢ **Security:** Apply access controls, masking, encryption and secure credential management in line with UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR.   
 ¢ **DevOps / DataOps:** Maintain code in source control and deploy through CI/CD pipelines, with automated tests and environment promotion.   
 ¢ **Operations and knowledge transfer:** Support production operations, incident resolution and runbooks, and coach SUTHERLAND engineers so that the pipelines can be sustained after   
 handover.   
 **Qualifications and Experience**   
 ¢ 4+ years in data engineering, preferably within UAE government or regulated-sector environments.   
 ¢ Advanced SQL, Python and PySpark/Spark skills.   
 ¢ Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or Synapse.   
 ¢ Strong understanding of Lakehouse/Medallion architecture, Delta/Parquet formats and   
 dimensional modelling, including SCDs and surrogate keys.   
 ¢ Experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub), source control and DataOps practices.   
 ¢ Familiarity with Microsoft Purview metadata and lineage, and with DQ tooling.   
 ¢ Awareness of UAE data regulation, including UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR.   
 ¢ Excellent English communication and documentation skills; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.

We architect analytical models and digital quoting workflows that empower global commodity teams to make faster, data-driven decisions that optimize product margins and maintain supply resilience.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As a Business Analyst in GSM Cost Operations, you will be a key driver of commodity cost intelligence, quarterly quote cycle governance, and digital transformation. You will lead end-to-end quarterly RFQ quoting cycles, partner with Commodity Managers to structure complex component pricing strategies, and build advanced models that eliminate cost gaps and mitigate spend variances. In this role, you will champion the adoption of modern Generative AI, machine learning tools, and automated agent workflows to transform operational quoting into a predictive, autonomous capability. This position offers visibility, cross-functional leadership opportunities, and a platform to shape the future of digital supply chain operations at scale.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Lead Strategic Commodity Quoting& Cost Operations:** Orchestrate end-to-end quarterly and annual RFQ quoting cycles across assigned strategic hardware commodities. Govern quote intake, attribute drift analysis (MOQ, CT2R, COO, PSL, MPN lifecycle), and standard cost roll-ups in Oracle CG1 within strict fiscal timelines.
  
**Architect Advanced Analytics:** Build dynamic simulative cost models and QoQ variance bridge models. Track and quantify cost, spend, savings, providing executive-ready insights.
  
**Drive Cost Hole Governance& cost Variance Mitigation:** Identify cost holes, diagnose, and resolve missing component costs prior to quarter-end standard cost freezes. Oversee Purchase Price Variance (PPV) claim validations, supplier buydown liabilities, and Material Usage Variance (MUV) root-cause mitigation across manufacturing sites.
  
**GenAI& Digital Workflow Automation:** Implement Generative AI tools, LLM prompt engineering, and automated agent workflows. Streamline supplier follow-ups and ideate and execute automation of manual activities.
  
**Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration& Process Excellence:** Partner closely with Supply channel Leads (SCL), Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain Product Managers, Finance, and Contract Manufacturers to resolve operational bottlenecks, enforce master data integrity (Control Codes, Sourcing Rules), and mentor junior analysts.

jobs.title: Retention & Renewal Analytics - CS Lead
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

  

We are seeking a data-driven CS Operations professional to lead retention and renewal operations and analytics within the Asia and Emerging Markets (AEM) Customer Success Operations team. In this role, you will own the operational and analytical frameworks that underpin renewal forecasting, churn risk identification, and revenue retention operations strategy. Reporting to the Director of CS Operations, you will serve as the analytical backbone for Customer Success Managers and leadership — including VP of Customer Success and CS Directors — translating complex customer data into clear, actionable intelligence that drives measurable retention outcomes.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Renewal Pipeline Analytics:** Own end-to-end analytics for the renewal pipeline — track renewal rates, ARR/ACV at risk, and on-time renewal performance across segments and regions; publish CS key metrics regularly.
* **Churn & Contraction Modelling:** Build and maintain predictive models to identify churn risk signals, contraction patterns, and at-risk cohorts; deliver proactive alerts to CS leadership and account teams.
* **Retention Performance Reporting:** Design and manage recurring retention dashboards and scorecards (weekly, monthly, QBR-level) surfacing retention metrics, win-back trends, and save-play effectiveness; leverage AI and automation tools to develop a programmatic approach for retention operations reporting.
* **Root Cause Analysis:** Lead post-churn or cancellation root cause analysis to identify systemic patterns; synthesise findings into actionable recommendations for Product, CS, and Commercial teams.
* **Renewal Process Optimisation:** Partner with CS and Finance to refine renewal workflows, escalation triggers, and SLA frameworks within tools like Gainsight and Salesforce.
* **Executive Storytelling:** Translate analytical findings into crisp executive narratives, supporting QBRs, exec-level reporting, and business reviews.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Sales Ops, Finance, and Product to align retention KPIs with broader go-to-market objectives.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, or a similar analytically focused role within a SaaS or subscription-based business.
* Proven expertise in renewal and retention operations and analytics, including Gross Retention Rate (GRR), Net Retention Rate (NRR), churn rate, logo retention, and ARR/ACV metrics.
* Advanced proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC) and Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight including experience building reports, dashboards, and customer lifecycle journeys.
* Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial and data modelling, scenario analysis, and cohort/funnel analysis.
* Hands-on experience with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent) for self-service dashboard development and executive reporting.
* Strong statistical aptitude — comfortable with cohort analysis, funnel analysis, and basic predictive modelling techniques.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to present data-driven narratives clearly and concisely to senior stakeholders.
* High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Background in revenue accounting or finance, particularly for ARR reconciliation and SaaS metrics reporting.
* Exposure to Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, Planhat, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting or leading digital Customer Success or tech-touch retention programmes at scale.
* Hands-on experience with AI-powered analytics or automation solutions integrated within CS or CRM workflows.
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management across cross-functional teams including Finance, Sales, and Product.
Exposure to global or multi-regional SaaS operations with an understanding of India-based delivery and GTM models.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Working knowledge of SQL or Python for data extraction and analysis; comfort with large datasets and data validation.
Familiarity with machine learning or propensity modelling frameworks applied to churn prediction (e.g., logistic regression, gradient boosting).

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager I - Data Mesh
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own DataMesh, one of Smartsheet’s most widely used cross-sheet data capabilities and a critical part of how enterprise customers build and run their solutions today. DataMesh sits at the centre of a multi-year shift in Smartsheet’s data model, as we evolve towards column links and, ultimately, relational data capabilities.
  
  
**You Will**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for DataMesh, balancing near-term stability and customer needs against the longer-term migration strategy
* Own the operational stability and serviceability of DataMesh, partnering with engineering and Support to prioritise defects, performance issues, and escalations
* Shape and execute the migration path from DataMesh to column links, working closely with the Data Links PM on feature parity, the advanced column links roadmap, and report-as-a-source as a critical dependency
* Lead customer and user discovery with enterprise personas (work admins, solution builders, system administrators, and power users) to understand how DataMesh is used in practice, identify migration blockers, and validate decisions before they ship
* Partner with Customer Success and GTM to plan communications, enablement, and migration support for enterprise accounts that depend on DataMesh
* Work with one or more engineering squads, navigating dependencies and making clear scoping and sequencing decisions across a complex, interconnected backlog
* Author clear product briefs, requirements docs, and feature specs that design and engineering can execute on without ambiguity
* Define success metrics for everything you ship, including DataMesh usage, migration progress, and quality indicators, and partner with data and analytics teams on instrumentation and reporting
* Represent DataMesh in leadership reviews, WBRs, and customer conversations, including enterprise account engagements
* Perform other duties as assigned

**You Have**

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering features within enterprise SaaS or B2B software products
* Experience with data management, data modelling, workflow automation, platform integrations, or cross-sheet data referencing is a strong plus
* Experience managing a mature product through sustain, deprecation, or migration phases is a plus
* Strong customer instincts: you can run structured discovery, synthesise customer feedback, and turn it into well-scoped, validated product decisions
* A track record of writing product briefs, requirements docs, and specs that engineering and design can act on without ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, GTM, and Customer Success
* Comfort working with engineering teams across time zones, including stakeholders in North America
* A data-driven mindset: you define adoption and quality metrics before you ship and use post-launch data to guide iteration
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confidence presenting in leadership reviews and speaking directly with enterprise customers
* Familiarity with API-driven product development or working alongside platform engineering teams is a plus
* Legally eligible to work in India on an ongoing basis
* Fluency in English is required

**Get To Know Us**
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.
  
  
If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

jobs.description:
**Description**
Amazon Prime Video's vision is to be the world's favorite entertainment brand and the first-choice entertainment hub globally. Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows, movies and live sports, all in one place where it is easy to find what they love to watch. Members can also subscribe to add-on channels (third-party streaming services) and rent new-release movies on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is at the forefront of the entertainment industry and growing fast, now available in 240 countries and territories worldwide. As a Senior Product Manager for Prime Video in India, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for one of our largest international markets. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About WorkIndia**

WorkIndia is India’s largest blue- and grey-collar hiring platform, built with a clear purpose: to provide meaningful livelihoods to 23.7 crore blue-collar individuals across India.

WorkIndia helps millions of job seekers connect with employers across the country. On the employer side, WorkIndia serves tens of thousands of businesses every month, enabling them to discover, evaluate, and hire relevant candidates at scale.

About the Product Organization

Our product teams focus on building long-term business outcomes across multiple employer journeys. Broadly, our employer-side charter spans:

* **Hunting:**
  Focuses on acquiring and converting new employers into paying customers through strong product-led growth and onboarding experiences.
* **Farming:**
  Focuses on helping existing employers succeed consistently by improving retention, expansion, and operational scalability through product systems.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Product Manager with 3–5 years of experience**
to work on Employer Acquisition within the Hunting charter, owning end-to-end growth, conversion, and user experience.

You will define what to build, validate it through experimentation, and work with cross-functional stakeholders to ship impactful products.

This role requires strong execution ownership, first-principles thinking, user empathy, data fluency, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

1. Ownership

* Own the product roadmap, driving growth, retention, UX, and funnel performance.
* Translate business goals into a clear roadmap and product priorities.
* Identify high-impact opportunities to improve conversion, activation, and user experience.
* Balance short-term execution with the long-term health of the product.

2. User Thinking & Product Judgment

* Develop a deep understanding of user needs, behaviours, and pain points.
* Ensure product decisions are grounded in real user outcomes.
* Translate user insights into scalable product improvements.
* Advocate for user impact while balancing business constraints.

3. Business & Product Leadership

* Own business outcomes for the product, not just individual features.
* Connect product decisions to measurable business impact.
* Partner with business teams to ensure product strategy reflects business goals.
* Influence cross-functional priorities and drive alignment with partner teams.

4. Execution & Systems Thinking

* Write clear PRDs with well-defined goals, scope, and success criteria.
* Design and run A/B experiments to validate major bets, including sizing, rollout percentage, and result analysis.
* Drive high-quality execution by working closely with Engineering and Design teams through to launch.
* Identify recurring product problems and propose scalable solutions rather than one-off fixes.
* Anticipate risks and proactively adjust plans.

5. Data & Decision-Making

* Use data to drive prioritisation and product problem discovery.
* Leverage analytics and experimentation to validate hypotheses.
* Own product metrics and outcomes end-to-end.
* Distinguish meaningful business outcomes from vanity metrics.

6. Cross-Functional Leadership

* Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Customer Experience (CX), Sales, and Marketing to ship and scale products.
* Create clarity in ambiguous situations and resolve trade-offs constructively.
* Lead through influence with peers and cross-functional partners.

What We’re Looking For

* 3–5 years of Product Management experience.
* Experience in marketplace or consumer internet products is preferred.
* Proven experience designing and running end-to-end A/B experiments, including sizing, rollout percentage, and result analysis, in close collaboration with Design.
* A track record of shipping user-facing features that have delivered measurable results.
* Strong data fluency and the ability to use data for prioritisation and storytelling.
* Comfort operating in ambiguous environments.

Team & Reporting

* **Reports to:**
  Group Product Manager
* **Key Stakeholders:**
  Business, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, and Sales.

Why Join WorkIndia?

* **Impact:**
  Be part of a mission-driven company that impacts millions of lives every day.
* **Growth:**
  Work in a high-ownership environment where your initiatives directly shape the company’s growth and culture.
* **Location:**
  HSR Layout, Bangalore.

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Product Manager for AI at GE Vernova plays a crucial role in the development and execution of AI-powered products that transform business processes. This role is essential to our mission of pioneering AI-driven innovation and enhancing user experiences across the enterprise.
  
  
The Product Manager will work with across GE Vernova and with the AI Portfolio Manager to identify, prioritize and build out AI products. These products (several) focus on delivering improvements and value through the lens of the Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) framework, measuring the impact of AI initiatives.
  
  
Additionally, the Product Manager facilitates cross-business coordination, leveraging AI applications to drive operational improvements and foster innovation across Vernova. Expertise in AI, combined with strong business acumen, is pivotal in translating complex technical challenges into strategic opportunities that propel the organization forward. These duties extend to not only internally developed solutions, but also to external suppliers (e.g. 3rd party software).
  
  
As a GE Vernova accelerator, GE Vernova Advanced Research is driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.
  
  
Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy-focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.
  
  
**Job Description**
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Product Ownership and Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business, engineering, and research, to develop and execute product roadmaps that align with strategic objectives.
* Roadmap input: Provide input, alongside the Portfolio manager, to build the product roadmaps
* Technical Collaboration: Work closely with data scientists, IT, and designers to ensure the development of robust AI solutions, maintaining technical rigor and introducing new methods for verifying success and identifying risks.
* User Experience: Focus on delivering exceptional user experiences by understanding and addressing user needs in AI applications.
* Cross-Business Coordination: Support the coordination of AI applications to drive improvements and innovations across Vernova.
* Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize data analytics to measure product performance and make informed decisions. Define and monitor metrics and KPIs to ensure the success and impact of AI initiatives.
* Post-Launch Support: Monitor product performance post-launch, gather user feedback, and iterate on product features to enhance value delivery.
* 3rd party solutions: Oversee the interjection of AI products coming from 3rd party software suppliers and determine best technology fit.

**Position Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, with 10+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience with GE/GE Vernova highly preferred.
* Business Acumen: Ability to integrate business strategy with technical initiatives.
* Leadership: Proven leadership in managing cross-functional teams and projects.
* Communication Skills: Excellent communication and presentation skills to engage with diverse stakeholders and occasionally C-Suite executives.
* Experience building and deploying AI applications.
* Problem-Solving Skills: Analytical skills to identify and solve risks and challenges.
* Technical Proficiency and Data-Driven Mindset

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Digital Services AI
jobs.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
The Digital Services AI Product team is building the foundation for the next generation of help experiences on eBay. We are focused on making support personalized, effortless, fast, and trusted, providing seamless help where and when customers need it.
  
  
With hundreds of millions of listings and a global community of buyers and sellers, eBay’s scale creates a unique opportunity to transform how people find help, resolve issues, and navigate an increasingly complex global commerce and regulatory environment. We are developing an ecosystem of AI Agents and composable AI platforms that enable adaptive, scalable help experiences across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
As a Senior Product Manager, you will define and lead the strategy for how we design, build, and scale AI-powered help experiences, including capabilities that help eBay address
**product regulatory compliance requirements and policies at scale**
. You will work closely with design, engineering, data science, operations, policy, legal, and compliance teams to turn emerging AI capabilities, customer needs, and regulatory requirements into simple, trusted, and impactful products for customers and the business.
  
  
What You Will Accomplish
  
  

* Define the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for AI Agents, composable AI platforms, and capabilities supporting product regulatory compliance and trusted commerce experiences.
* Identify opportunities to use AI, automation, and data to improve how regulatory requirements and product policies are understood, operationalized, and surfaced across customer experiences.
* Translate customer, business, policy, and regulatory needs into clear, actionable product direction and requirements.
* Partner with Legal, Policy, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Engineering, Design, and Data Science to build scalable solutions that balance customer experience, regulatory obligations, and business objectives.
* Use data and experimentation to guide decisions, measure impact, identify emerging risks, and drive continuous improvement.
* Bring customer insights, regulatory developments, data, and industry trends together to inform product strategy and improve the product experience.
* Develop scalable capabilities that can adapt to evolving product regulations, marketplace policies, and requirements across markets and jurisdictions.
* Partner closely with design, engineering, and data science to deliver reliable, explainable, and high-quality AI-powered products at scale.
* Build alignment and strong partnerships across teams to stay focused on shared goals and drive execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives.
* Keep customer trust, safety, and ease of use at the center of product decisions while enabling eBay to meet its regulatory and policy commitments.

What You Will Bring
  
  

* 6+ years of product management experience, ideally including experience with AI/ML, data-driven products, trust, risk, compliance, policy, or marketplace platforms.
* Experience applying AI and automation to improve customer experiences and solve complex customer or business problems, such as conversational AI, decisioning, classification, policy interpretation, or workflow automation.
* Experience working on product regulatory compliance, trust, risk, policy, or other regulated product domains is highly valued.
* Ability to translate complex regulatory, policy, operational, and technical requirements into scalable product capabilities and intuitive customer experiences.
* Skilled at using data and insights to uncover opportunities, drive prioritization, assess risk, and measure success.
* Technical fluency and foresight to collaborate effectively with engineers, data scientists, and AI/ML teams.
* Strong judgment when working with AI-powered products where accuracy, explainability, customer trust, and regulatory compliance are important.
* High ownership mindset with a bias for action and focus on creating customer and business impact.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams, including Legal, Compliance, Policy, and Operations.
* Experience building 0→1 products and navigating ambiguity, evolving requirements, and complex stakeholder environments with confidence.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, customer support, self-service, trust, risk, or regulatory technology is a plus but not required.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Yulu**

Yulu is India’s leading shared micro-mobility platform, revolutionizing urban transportation through smart, sustainable, and electric-first mobility solutions. With a rapidly growing fleet of tech-enabled electric two-wheelers and a robust battery-swapping infrastructure, Yulu makes last-mile commutes not only efficient but also planet-friendly.

Our IoT-driven platform and smart electric vehicles are helping cities reduce traffic congestion and carbon emissions while empowering millions with affordable and reliable transportation.

Backed by industry giants like Bajaj Auto and Magna International, Yulu operates at the intersection of mobility, technology, and sustainability. Our mission is to reduce congestion, cut emissions, and transform how India moves — one ride at a time.

With millions of rides completed, thousands of EVs on the road, and a rapidly expanding footprint, we’re not just building EVs — we’re building the future of urban mobility in India.

🔗 Learn more: www.yulu.bike

**Role Summary**

As a Product Manager at Yulu, you will own the product experience for gig workers who rely on Yulu for their daily mobility, from the rental journey to battery swaps. Your goal is to make every ride seamless, reliable, and cost-efficient so gig workers can maximize their earnings. Working with engineering, data science, business, and operations, you will use user insights, real-time analytics, and AI-driven optimization to improve gig worker satisfaction and retention.

If you thrive on solving real-world user pain points, improving financial outcomes for gig workers, and building scalable mobility solutions, join us in shaping the future of electric last-mile mobility!

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the gig worker journey end-to-end, from rental to battery swaps, removing friction at every step.
* Define the product vision and strategy for the gig worker experience, grounded in user insights and business goals.
* Build and prioritize the roadmap around measurable outcomes: gig worker earnings, satisfaction, and retention.
* Drive products from ideation to launch and scale, iterating continuously on what the data and the field show.

**Collaboration & Execution**

* Own Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), integrating insights from engineering, business, and customer support, and socialize them to align teams on scope and expectations.
* Work with founders and cross-functional teams in a matrix setup, balancing stakeholder needs to deliver high-impact solutions.
* Act as a product advocate, articulating product value and upcoming enhancements, and run demos to drive adoption and gather feedback.
* Proactively address roadmap bottlenecks, working with the team to ensure seamless execution and the achievement of product goals.

**Innovation & Growth**

* Identify and drive new product ideas and enhancements from user and stakeholder insights.
* Scale the gig worker experience as Yulu expands into new cities and markets.

**Metrics & Insights**

* Set OKRs and success metrics for the gig worker experience, and review them regularly with the team.
* Measure the impact of every launch, using experiments and funnel analysis across the rental and battery swap journeys to decide what to build next.
* Spend regular time in the field with gig workers and ops teams, combining what you see with support and usage data to find the biggest pain points.
* Flag risks early and drive solutions to complex problems.

**Key Requirements**

* B.Tech / MBA or equivalent practical experience in product management.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, with a proven track record of delivering impactful products.
* Experience building consumer-facing mobile products used daily at scale, ideally in mobility, logistics, quick-commerce, or on-demand delivery.
* Ability to define, track, and drive product outcomes through clear metrics, OKRs, and data-led decisions.
* Hands-on use of AI tools in daily product workflows, from input collection and research to documentation and prototyping.
* A habit of spending time in the field with gig workers and ops teams, turning direct user insights into product decisions.
* Deep ownership and a strong sense of urgency, with the ability to drive initiatives from ideation to execution in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**What We Offer**

* A collaborative and open culture where your ideas and opinions are valued.
* Challenging and rewarding problem statements that deepen your understanding of Product Management.
* A dynamic and growth-driven journey that pushes you to learn, innovate, and excel.
