jobs.description:
**About The Team**
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
  
  
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
  
  
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager 2 who is passionate about solving high-impact problems in a fast-paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.

**What You Will Need**

* Overall experience of 4+ yrs with at least 4+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem-solving skills based on first principles of thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: KYC QA Expert - Associate**

**Location: Bangalore, India**

  
  

**Role Description**

* Our global suite of cash management services offers a wide range of solutions to meet clients’ specific requirements thereby providing them with the time and means to concentrate on their core business.
* Furthermore, our market leading products and services enable our clients to reduce transaction costs, consolidate operations and expand revenue opportunities. Our award-winning client service centres are in all the relevant financial centres worldwide, providing clients with access to an unrivalled global network.
The Client KYC Officer supports the Institutional Cash Management/Trade Finance team covering financial institution clients within the respective team. The position works directly with the Accountable Client Owner (ACO) responsible for the client relationships with our correspondent banking/trade finance clients to complete client KYC adoptions and reviews, ensuring strict adherence to Deutsche Bank’s KYC / Anti Money Laundering (AML) Compliance requirements. Further, the role also fulfils important support functions in the non-financial risk management of client relationships, such as analysis of clients’ transaction flow. Today’s regulatory and compliance environment requires a robust and efficient KYC process and strong non-financial risk management, making the role key to the first line of defence role of the business.  

  

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under child care assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* KYC Risk Management including active client research and screening prospective clients before/during on-boarding as well as part of on-going periodic review process
* Direct client outreach, collecting information & documentation according to periodic review timelines and follow up to ensure complete and timely delivery, complete relevant KYC forms / systems and updating of client KYC profiles driven by material events

* Accuracy, diligence, and the ability to deliver high quality results within tight deadlines combined with strong analytical skills and ability to work under pressure

jobs.title: Technical Implementation and Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you…

Interested in working for an international and diverse company?

Looking to use your troubleshooting skill?

Looking for a friendly and supporting team?

Flexible and comfortable working in Shifts?

If so, read on!

Esko, a Veralto company, is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our products empower teams to support and manage the packaging design and print processes for brand owners, retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to provide the most innovative, integrated platform and comprehensive portfolio of tools that intelligently digitize, connect, automate, and accelerate the concept to market processes for every packaged product.

You will be part of a flexible, family friendly organization that cares about its people just as it cares about the environment.

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence. Therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.  
The Technical implementation and support specialist is responsibleto lead customer implementations, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and ensure seamless platform adoption. The role offers an opportunity to work on a fast-growing SaaS platform, drive customer success across global markets, and collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams. You will own end-to-end implementation, integrations, technical onboarding, and L2/L3 support while helping shape scalable processes for a rapidly expanding customer base and will be located in remote or hybrid set up.

  

### **In this role, a typical day will look like:**

* Lead end-to-end technical implementation and onboarding of customers on the WCRGO platform, ensuring timely go-live and successful adoption.
* Configure workflows, troubleshoot technical challenges, and support customers with integrations and platform-related requirements.
* Provide L1/L2 technical support, investigate complex issues, and drive timely resolution in collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.
* Manage customer transitions from legacy systems and other platforms to WCRGO, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
* Conduct technical training sessions, product walkthroughs, and knowledge-transfer sessions for customers and internal teams.
* Identify recurring issues, document solutions, and contribute to improving implementation processes, support documentation, and platform stability.

### **The essential requirements of the job include:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5-7 years of experience in technical implementation, application support, SaaS delivery, or enterprise software environments.
* Hands-on experience with SaaS platform configuration, workflow management, API integrations, and technical troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of SQL, REST APIs, JSON, and debugging tools to investigate and resolve technical issues.
* Flexibility to work in shifts, based on business requirements.
* Experience working with ticketing and support platforms such as Zendesk, Jira, ServiceNow, or equivalent tools.

Travel: Willingness to travel occasionally for customer implementations, training, and critical technical engagements (approximately 10–15% travel, depending on business requirements).

At Esko, a Veralto Company, innovation comes in every color and never in the same package. Join Esko and see how diversity of people and thought fuels a career journey like no other. Create unique technology solutions for the packaging value chain, bring new ideas to life, make and influence decisions, and experience career growth, rewards, and recognition in our global Packaging & Color organizations.

Esko is proud to be a Product Quality & Innovation company in Veralto (NYSE: VLTO). Imagine a world where everyone has access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. That is the tomorrow Veralto is creating today. Veralto is a $5B global leader in essential technology solutions made up of over 16,000 associates across our Water Quality and Product Identification segments all united by a powerful purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

**Unsolicited Assistance**

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

jobs.description:
**Who we are**
--------------

Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.

Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.

At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.

**Job Snapshot**
----------------

We are looking for a **Client Partner** who will serve as a strategic advisor and trusted long-term partner to Mindtickle's most important enterprise clients. This is not a traditional account management role; it sits at the intersection of management consulting, client engagement, and business transformation. You will own the end-to-end client relationship post-contract: driving value delivery, shaping how clients embed Mindtickle into their revenue strategy, and influencing C-suite stakeholders on long-term business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings a structured, hypothesis-driven approach to client problems, is comfortable operating at the executive level, and has a track record of driving measurable impact within complex, multi-stakeholder engagements.

This is a US Shift role. The timings can be from 4 pm - 1 am or 6:30 pm - 3:30 am IST.

### **What's in it for you?**

* Diagnose client business challenges using structured frameworks, and design tailored engagement plans that connect Mindtickle's capabilities to measurable revenue outcomes.
* Lead executive-level conversations - QBRs, EBRs, and strategic planning sessions, with C-suite and senior VP stakeholders, presenting insights and influencing decision-making.
* Build and execute detailed client success plans with clear milestones, owners, and business impact metrics.
* Drive product adoption by understanding client workflows, identifying change management barriers, and designing programmes that embed Mindtickle into core sales processes.
* Proactively identify risks to client outcomes and renewals, developing and executing mitigation strategies before issues escalate.
* Identify and build the commercial case for expansion opportunities (cross-sell and upsell) grounded in demonstrated business value.
* Track and report on engagement health using metrics including ROI, MAU, GRR, NRR, and client health scores, and use data to drive prioritisation decisions.
* Serve as a structured voice of the client internally, working cross-functionally with Product, Professional Services, and Support to resolve issues and shape the roadmap.
* Contribute to the development of scalable engagement methodologies, playbooks, and best practices across the Client Partner team.

### **We’d love to hear from you, if you:**

* Have 1-3+ years of experience in management consulting, client engagement, or strategic advisory, ideally with direct experience delivering post-sale value to enterprise clients.
* Are skilled at structuring ambiguous client problems, developing clear recommendations, and driving implementation, not just advising from the sidelines.
* Have led complex, multi-stakeholder programmes and can manage competing priorities across a portfolio of large accounts simultaneously.
* Are confident presenting to and influencing C-level executives and senior business leaders, with the ability to adapt your communication style to the audience.
* Bring strong commercial acumen, you understand how enterprise businesses work, can build a credible ROI narrative, and know how to tie product value to board-level priorities.
* Are data-driven: comfortable building analyses, tracking business impact metrics, and using data to tell a compelling story.
* Have deep knowledge of SaaS business models, enterprise software ecosystems, and how technology-driven change gets adopted inside large organisations.
* Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex information into clear, actionable insights.
* Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and take ownership of outcomes rather than process.

### **Preferred Experience:**

* 1-3 years of total experience in a client-facing consulting or post-sale engagement role at a top-tier firm (e.g., MBB, Big 4, Tier-1 strategy boutique) or in an enterprise SaaS environment.
* Demonstrated track record of owning client outcomes end-to-end from diagnostic through delivery and commercial renewal.
* Experience working with or selling into enterprise revenue teams (Sales, Sales Ops, Revenue Enablement, L&D) is a strong advantage.
* Familiarity with revenue enablement, sales effectiveness, or go-to-market transformation programmes.
* Experience navigating large, matrixed client organisations and building relationships across multiple business units.
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree from a top-tier institution, preferred.

### **Success Metrics:**

* % Monthly Active Users (MAU).

jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
The
**Senior Product Owner**
is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform.
  
  
This role is specifically focused on Core HCM, Onboarding & Security. Additional module expertise is a plus. This role has a defined growth path: as the team matures, the Product Owner will take on line management responsibility for an Associate Product Owner, growing into a player-manager who both delivers and develops.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities
  
  
Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery**

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): Core HCM, Security and Onbaording end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap & Release Ownership**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands-On Delivery**

* Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to review, validate, and contribute to configuration work alongside the Associate Product Owner.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Review and approve design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Support the Associate Product Owner(s) in day-to-day delivery, providing guidance, review, and quality oversight.

**Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking**

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Team Development**

* In the near term, work closely with and provide functional guidance to the Associate Product Owner(s) aligned to your module area.
* As the team grows, take on formal line management responsibility for your Associate Product Owner — supporting their development, performance, and career growth.

**Required Qualifications**

jobs.title: Executive Product Owner - Enterprise Knowledge Fabric
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Executive Product Owner - Enterprise Knowledge Fabric
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
The Enterprise Knowledge Domain is a newly established capability and a foundational pillar of the Group's artificial intelligence strategy. The team will define how organisational knowledge is structured, governed, connected and made available across the enterprise. It will work closely with engineering, architecture, data, scientific and business communities to create trusted knowledge foundations that support enterprise search, knowledge discovery and intelligent systems.
  
  
Within the domain, the Knowledge Fabric team builds and operates the federated context layer that connects these foundations to people and AI agents, and the Product Owner makes sure it is adopted and delivers value.
  
  
**Impact and Contribution:**
As Exec Product Owner for the Knowledge Fabric, you will own the fabric as a platform product. You will set the roadmap and prioritise the backlog across the context layer, retrieval and MCP services, knowledge controls, and the consumption experience for AI agents and the harnesses they run in, including Agents.CBA, CommbankOS, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and OpenAI Codex.
  
  
You will onboard the teams building enterprise agents, user agents and user-defined agents, and make sure the fabric meets their needs for relevance, speed, security and cost. You will define and track platform measures such as retrieval latency, relevance, token cost and entitlement conformance, and coordinate closely with the Chief Data Office, Chief AI Office and End User Experience teams to bring use cases and domains live on the Knowledge Fabric.
  
  
**You are a platform product leader who can make a complex technical capability simple, valuable and easy for other teams to adopt.**
The Knowledge Fabric is building world-leading knowledge management capabilities for our AI-powered colleagues and agents. Together, we will make trusted, permission-aware knowledge available to the AI agents that need it, through a single, consistent retrieval point.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Own the product vision, roadmap and prioritised backlog for the Knowledge Fabric platform. Drive product exploration (e.g. using design thinking and analytics) and formulate hypotheses to validate product strategy / design.
* Translate consumer and architecture needs into clear features and acceptance criteria for the context layer, retrieval and MCP services, and knowledge controls.
* Accountable for end-to-end value delivery and product lifecycle management (including managing requirements lifecycle, production deployment and release day coordination and sign off).
* Assess and implement build vs buy decisions to enable platform and capability build
* Act as the voice of the customer and business and translate this for the squad. Apply expertise to support prioritisation, balance trade-offs, and explore strategies to successfully achieve business and customer outcomes.
* Lead the onboarding of consuming agent teams across multiple harnesses, with clear documentation, service expectations and support.
* Define and report platform KPIs, including latency, relevance, token cost, availability and entitlement conformance.
* Work with the Chief Engineer to balance new capability, reliability, security and technical debt.
* Ensure entitlements, fine-grained permissions and agent-specific access controls are reflected in product requirements and evidenced for risk stakeholders.
* Coordinate roadmaps and dependencies with the Chief Data Office, Chief AI Office, End User Experience and the Knowledge Domain products.
* Track and report progress in bringing use cases and domains live on the Knowledge Fabric. Manage the squad’s performance to defined objectives including OKR tracking, etc.
* Ensure all obligations across customer, regulatory, internal policy and process frameworks (e.g. GDF, PDDP, RiC) are fully met and satisfied. Identify, articulate and manage risks, dependencies and compliance across streams of work (e.g. customer propositions).

**Essential Skills:**

* Have owned technical platform, API or data products used by other engineering teams.
* Product strategy, vision setting, roadmap creation, and outcome-based prioritisation.
* Understand how AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, graph network and LLM applications consume context, and what makes retrieval good.
* Ability to assess and implement build vs buy decisions to enable platform and capability build.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and product-thinking skills to translate business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.
* Can turn complex technical and risk requirements into clear priorities and acceptance criteria.
* Use data and metrics to make product decisions and demonstrate value.
* Understanding of risk, governance, compliance, and responsible AI principles in regulated environments.
* Can align multiple teams with competing priorities towards a shared roadmap.
* Build trusted working relationships with engineers, architects, risk partners and business teams.
* Ideally bring experience in Model Context Protocol, agent platforms, search or data platforms, identity and access management, or cost optimisation for AI workloads.

Bachelors or Master's Degree in any stream

**Who Are We?**  
  
Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. This role will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing reports and dashboards using Workday reporting tools, including Advanced Reports, Composite Reports, Matrix Reports, Dashboards, and Workday Prism Analytics. Maintain confidentiality and appropriate governance of sensitive employee and business data.  

  

**What Else?**
--------------

  

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.

  

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

  

**Our Values**
--------------

  

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

  

**Equal Opportunity**
---------------------

  

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

“Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with
**Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award**
and has been ranked
**Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by Avtar & Seramount**
. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.

**WHY JOIN CAPCO?**

You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.

**MAKE AN IMPACT**

Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.

**#BEYOURSELFATWORK**

Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.

**CAREER ADVANCEMENT**

With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.

**DIVERSITY & INCLUSION**

We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage

DATA PRIVACY – BUSINESS ANALYST

**Job Summary: -**

Data privacy experts manage website tracking mechanisms, cookie consent banners, telemetry, and first/third-party data collection practices to ensure legal compliance while preserving business analytics and marketing needs.

Skills and Competencies: -

• Business Analysis Excellence – Strong ability to gather, structure, and document re-quirements across business and data domains using Agile framework • Analytical Thinking – Ability to assess complex data flows, identify gaps, and perform root cause analysis • Collaboration & Influencing – Builds effective relationships across business, risk, and technology teams • Communication Skills – Clear articulation of privacy concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. • Privacy Mindset – Strong understanding of data privacy, cookies, consent, privacy princi-ples, data subject rights • Execution Focus – Ability to drive deliverables in a structured and timely manner within programme constraints • Adaptability – Comfortable working in evolving environments with shifting priorities and limited baseline documentation

Soft Skills: -

Ability to translate complex legal and technical jargon into clear, actionable guidance for non-technical stakeholders Technical Proficiency: • Understanding of HTTP headers, JavaScript tags, DOM storage, and browser cookies. • Experience with Tag Management Systems (Google Tag Manager, Adobe Launch). • Familiarity with website crawler and proxy tools etc.

Role and Responsibilities: -

• 8-10 years of strong functional experience in Data Privacy, Data Protection, Cookies, Consent Privacy Notice, Data Subject Rights • Preferred: Knowledge of GDPR and other country privacy requirements (e.g. SG PDPA) and its implication to Banks; Implementation of GDPR or equivalent country regulation for a banking organization • Knowledge or practical experience of implementing privacy by design (PbD) concepts in large banks to aid in meeting privacy needs • Identify all existing group level standards / processes and frameworks impacted by privacy e.g. Data Privacy Standards, Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) process, ROPA, Cloud governance process, API Management etc. • Hands on configuring ‘One Trust’ tool being cookies expert of any other cookies platform/tool • Strong BA experience • Familiarity with consent management platform (CMP) – Good to have hands on one trust • Someone who can be easily trained with past cookies management experience & understanding how it works • Strong BA experience • Familiarity with consent management platform (CMP) – Good to have hands on one trust

Other Capabilities: -

• Strong stakeholder facilitation skills, including conducting structured interviews and work-shops with SMEs. • Ability to operate in ambiguity and work with incomplete documentation to derive struc-tured outputs. • Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to connect data, process, and control per-spectives. • Ability to translate complex data and regulatory concepts into clear, actionable insights. • Collaborative working style across global, cross-functional teams. • Self-driven with ability to manage multiple priorities in a programme-driven environment.

Certifications: -

Preferred • CIPP/E (Certified Information Privacy Professional/Europe) or CIPP/US • CIPM (Certified Information Privacy Manager) • CIPT (Certified Information Privacy Technologist)

jobs.title: Functional Business Consultant
jobs.description:
**What We Do**
msg global is a consulting and system integration company with a strong focus on the insurance and reinsurance industry. We support our clients in designing, transforming, and implementing integrated IT architectures across end‑to‑end business processes. With deep industry expertise, we deliver high‑quality SAP‑based solutions tailored to the specific requirements of insurance and reinsurance organizations.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Business Analyst, you will collaborate closely with msg global project teams and customer stakeholders to deliver SAP for reinsurance implementations. Your responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Analyzing, specifying, testing, and documenting reinsurance business processes
* Designing integrated and sustainable system landscapes
* Participating in process flow analysis, redesign, and business process optimization
* Designing transition maps, roadmaps, implementation, integration, and migration strategies
* Providing functional consulting expertise to reinsurance clients
* Defining best practices and evaluating third‑party solution alternatives as part of functional design documents
* Coordinating with business process owners and technical teams to design, customize, and implement SAP for reinsurance solutions
* Supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Participating in training, design, documentation, and delivery activities in alignment with the Project Manager
* Contributing to internal projects as required
* Traveling to client locations up to 80% of the time

**What We Are Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced and motivated professional with strong domain and consulting skills, including:
  
  

* Excellent knowledge of Reinsurance and insurance business processes, particularly for P&C lines of business
* Several years of experience in business consulting and package‑based implementation projects
* Strong understanding of integrated IT architectures and SAP implementation methodologies (e.g., ASAP)
* Ability to manage complex initiatives with minimal supervision
* Very strong analytical, conceptual, and problem‑solving skills
* A proactive mindset with a strong willingness to learn
* Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic work environment
* Strong customer focus and a service‑oriented, self‑driven approach to work
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Excellent written and spoken English
* Experience working directly with clients, business stakeholders, and functional teams
* SAP for Insurance/Reinsurance knowledge is an added advantage

**What We Offer**

* A place where individuals are equally valued and where diversity and cultural differences are cherished.
* A global team of highly respected developers and industry experts where you can make a difference.
* Competitive salaries and a broad range of benefits, some of which are highlighted below.
* The opportunity to work on complex and challenging reinsurance transformation projects
* Exposure to global clients and collaboration with experienced international teams
* A key role in shaping business processes and IT architectures for leading reinsurance organizations
* A professional environment that values expertise, independence, and continuous learning
* Opportunities to contribute to both client projects and internal initiatives
* Career growth within a specialized reinsurance consulting organization

**Benefits**

* Health Insurance: We provide hospitalization and non-hospitalization benefits like annual medical screening and mental health assistance program for employees and their dependents.
* Employee Wellbeing: We provide various options for sport and recreation benefits.
* Job for Friends: Get your friends on board through our employee referral program, and we will reward you.
* Flexible Working: We offer flexible work schedules, including flexible start and end times as well as remote and/or hybrid work.
* Anniversary & Success Milestones: We celebrate your work anniversaries and success by rewarding your loyalty and dedication.
* Gift Vouchers: We share your happiness with you and provide vouchers for newborns, wedding, work anniversaries, annual and festival gifts.
* Team Events: We celebrate our success with team-building activities throughout the year.
* Training and Development: We provide a broad training portfolio for personal and professional growth, including unlimited access to course platform to all our employees.
